title: SOC Home Lab - Detection Overview
description: Dashboard Studio definition visualising the lab's MITRE ATT&CK detections. Import via Splunk > Dashboards > Create New Dashboard > Dashboard Studio > Source.

viz_failed_logins.title: Failed Logins by Source IP (Brute Force - T1110)

options.query: index=windows EventCode=4625 | stats count by src_ip, Account_Name | where count > 5 | sort - count

index=windows (EventCode=4688 OR (source="*Sysmon*" EventCode=1)) CommandLine="*powershell*" (CommandLine="*-enc*" OR CommandLine="*IEX*" OR CommandLine="*DownloadString*") | stats count by CommandLine, User, host | sort - count
index=windows source="*Sysmon*" EventCode=10 TargetImage="*\\lsass.exe" | stats count
index=windows EventCode=7045 | table _time ServiceName ServiceFileName host | sort - _time

index=windows (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=7045 OR EventCode=1102 OR (source="*Sysmon*" (EventCode=10 OR EventCode=13))) | eval technique=case(EventCode=4625,"T1110 Brute Force", EventCode=7045,"T1543 New Service", EventCode=1102,"T1070 Log Clear", EventCode=10,"T1003 Cred Dump", EventCode=13,"T1547 Persistence") | stats count by technique
